name: Kasugayama Castle
scope: Central surviving Kasugayama mountain castle earthworks, including the summit, southwest keep and well terraces, second enclosure and eastern spur approach.
era: Present standing archaeological earthworks and site markers.

stories.title: Kasugayama Castle: Fortress of the Dragon of Echigo
